verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with more than 120 actions, an API sandbox, versioning, and an MCP server, but no official SDKs or client libraries in any language. A raw HTTP API is a developer building block, not the SDK this story asks for, and an MCP server is a separate capability. Official SDKs are a fair thing to expect from a registrar platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
